fee_notes: Two payment options: (1) $75,000 payable as $37,500 upon execution plus 11 monthly installments of $3,409 each, or (2) $65,000 discounted lump sum upon execution. Remote Branch Amendment $30,000, Satellite Branch Amendment $15,000, Remote Branch Conversion $20,000. All franchise fees fully earned at payment and nonrefundable. No renewal fee if compliance met.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us an Initial Franchise Fee when you sign the Franchise Agreement. The Initial Franchise Fee is $75,000. The fee for a Remote Branch Amendment is $30,000 payable in full when you sign the Remote Branch Amendment. If you are signing a Franchise Agreement based upon conversion of a Remote Branch to a franchise, as described in the Remote Branch Amendment, the Franchis e Fee is $20,000. The fee for a Satellite Branch Amendment is $1 5,000 payable in full at the time you purchase the Satellite Branch Amendment. You have two options for paying the Initial Franchise Fee: (1) pay $75,000 in installments of $37,500 upon execution of the Franchise Agreement and the remaining $37,500 in eleven consecutive monthly installment payments of $3,409 each; or (2) pay a discounted lump sum initial Franchise Fee of $65,000 when you sign the Franchise Agreement.
